name: openDesk
concept: Element as the chat app of openDesk, the sovereign office suite of ZenDiS for the German public sector. The pure variants copy the shipped openDesk CE theme (primary #571EFA, navy #203257, portal grey, Open Sans, the suite top bar and app switcher) so Element blends in with portal, Nextcloud and OX; daylight follows the office clock; usable targets BITV 2.0; classic reconstructs the 2023 Sovereign Workplace look; 2028 imagines opendesk.eu's marketing language in the product; Hyperdesk is the neon night take.

sources.title: openDesk deployment repo v1.19.3 — helmfile/environments/default/theme.yaml.gotmpl (colours, logos, app icons)
openDesk Element values (custom_themes openDesk / openDesk Dark, banner module)
openDesk deployment v0.3.0 (Sep 2023) theme.yaml — 2023 primary #5e27dd, white header wordmark
openDesk deployment v0.5.66 (Dec 2023) Element values — Nordeck opendesk banner module
opendesk.eu design tokens (assets/css/output.css: primary/secondary/neutral ramps, Space Grotesk + Open Sans)
Live openDesk CE v1.19.3 at od.blackpony.club: portal, Keycloak login, Nextcloud, OX, Element (screenshots in research/opendesk/)

limits: Calls/widgets (Element Call, Jitsi, NeoBoard) are iframes: they only follow the light/dark base.

On a real openDesk deployment the suite bar is openDesk's own banner module (io.element.element-web-modules.banner); the theme restyles it but its app menu content comes from the Intercom Service (ICS), not from the theme.

The theme's own suite bar/app switcher appears only where no banner module is configured; its app links come from config (de.datanauten.theme_loader.opendesk.apps) or openDesk's default host names on chat.<domain>.
openDesk's custom home page (custom-home.html) and Keycloak login are outside Element; only Element's own auth screens are themed.
Brand fonts: openDesk products use Open Sans (portal) / Inter (Element); Space Grotesk is only the marketing site's display face (used for 2028 and Hyperdesk).
The 2023 'classic' look is reconstructed from the v0.3–0.5 deployment theme values and logos; no full 2023 Element screenshots were available.

variants.name: openDesk · Light
variants.tagline: Element as the chat app of the openDesk suite — portal canvas, navy text, violet #571EFA, Open Sans.
signature: 64px white suite bar: app grid + openDesk wordmark → portal, 'Chat' label (or openDesk's own banner, restyled)
Selected room = filled #571EFA pill with white text (Nextcloud navigation)
Home space = the openDesk duotone chat app tile
Navy #203257 text on #f5f5f5 / white, Open Sans
Portal buttons: filled violet 4px, outline secondary; Keycloak-style 12px dialogs
